title: jumellea jumelleana
intro: Jumellea jumelleana, commonly known as the 'Yellow Coral Orchid', is a species of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Jumellea jumelleana include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit neuroprotective effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
